title: Script-proved authority-carrying portal lattice
summary: Carry a requested-place identity token from a correct same-frame SCIL proof only onto portal proposals admitted by an independent truth-blind structural opportunity gate; preserve UNKNOWN, no-portal, and representation-OOD states without COMMIT.

mechanisms.name: Asymmetric identity token plus structural portal opportunity
mechanisms.description: Hash the SCIL proof authority, frame identity, requested entity, image, and sealed PB4 result into a typed token. Attach it only to top-three paired-handle proposals satisfying a frozen score, scale, and image-position predicate. Human portal truth evaluates output but never controls authorization.
mechanisms.limitations: The first truth-blind composition gate retained correct authorized portal truth on only 1/3 positives and falsely authorized 1/2 no-portal controls. Geometry-only opportunity authorization is closed on that cohort.
